class.name: NetwDisplayPlayhead
class.brief_description: Where one entity's display is looking, and the jitter buffer that decides it.
class.description: [member display_lag] is carried signed, so a forecasting playhead leads the newest tick the same way a dilating one trails it. Two rules make the buffer settle instead of chasing. [member smoothed_floor] eases toward what the link currently needs rather than taking it whole, and [member display_lag] only grows at the starvation rate once starvation has outlasted [member NetwDisplayDecl.starvation_grace_frames], so one late frame costs nothing. [codeblock] var dt := playhead.effective_tick(timing.display_tick) var starving := not history.has_tick_after(dt) playhead.dilate(decl, timing.frame_ticks, offset, recommended, starving) [/codeblock] Whether a history holds a sample is not this record's business, which is why [method dilate] is told that it starves rather than asked to find out.

method.name: dilate
method.description: Takes one control step: eases [member smoothed_floor] toward [method min_lag], counts the starvation, and moves [member display_lag]. Under the grace window the lag adapts toward the floor at [member NetwDisplayDecl.lag_adapt_rate]; past it the lag grows by [member NetwDisplayDecl.starvation_growth] of the frame, bounded by the floor plus [member NetwDisplayDecl.max_extra_dilation], so a starving stream buys margin without unbounded delay. Dilating without [param decl] is refused.

method.name: effective_tick
method.description: The newest tick a history must hold for this playhead not to be starving, which is the clock's display tick moved back by the whole ticks of [member display_lag].

method.name: place
method.description: Moves [member display_tick] to where this pump samples, and answers the fractional position inside that tick. A [param bracketed] playhead follows the clock one whole tick behind and drops its [member display_lag], because the peer that authors the stream has nothing to wait for. Every other playhead samples [member display_lag] behind the clock, fraction and all.

method.name: min_lag
method.description: The lag the link currently needs, in ticks: one snapshot interval plus a tick, less what the clock already trails by, plus whatever the clock recommends beyond that. A [constant NetwDisplayDecl.TIMELINE_FORECAST] timeline needs none, because it targets the newest sample and its tail projection covers the gaps a jitter buffer would have covered by waiting.

method.name: settle
method.description: Places the playhead at [method min_lag] rather than easing onto it, and forgets the starvation. This is what a reset means: there is no history left to be late.

members.member: Ticks this display trails the clock's display tick by, signed.
The tick the last pump sampled at, or [code]-1[/code] before the first one.
Ticks between snapshots this stream expects, the width [method min_lag] buffers.
The lag floor the buffer is easing toward, so it settles rather than chasing every sample.
Consecutive dilations that found nothing new to show, reset by the first that does.
